why: Both land on lowest-cost simple steel with profit per ton and cover all the key brutal facts, but Analysis 2 frames the hedgehog as buyable technology paired with an unbuyable egalitarian pay-for-output culture, and its top three stop-doing items include both no diversification outside steel and no reliance on import protection. Analysis 2 also has a tighter verdict, states its confidence explicitly, and flags the dossier's shaky historical claims, whereas Analysis 1 leads its stop-doing list with a mill pause and a flat-rolled ban and leaves protection and management layers lower down.
